_comment: Owners file of push PP-B (Plant palette redesign: one palette page, the /palette/ move and the honest states) of the Consortium v2 plan (knowledge/project/consortium-v2-plan.md section 'Plant palette redesign'; detail in knowledge/project/plant-palette-slices.md and knowledge/architecture/plant-palette-architecture.md). Supersedes scripts/plan/f1a-owners.json. Path -> stream per chunk: one owner per path per chunk; a path may change hands between chunks (store.ts main -> b2 -> b3 -> main; state/restore.ts main -> b1 -> b3). Patterns are repo-relative: '*' stays within a folder, '**' crosses folders. Chunks run in order; streams inside a chunk run in parallel (at most two building agents). Streams by feature: b1 your place, arriving and sharing; b2 the palette page and its shell; b3 your plants (after b2). 'shared' lists the locale files: each listed stream adds keys only under its own prefix and changes or deletes only the keys its edits name (owners.mjs check against the chunk base); the merge agent joins the blocks. Markers owned by later pushes are parked (removed from the tree in chunk 0, restored from 648baf2 by their owner), so the master zero-marker gate holds at the push. node scripts/plan/owners.mjs check <chunk> <stream> <base> --file scripts/plan/pp-b-owners.json fails a stream diff outside its rows. A file found needed mid-build is requested from the main agent, never taken.
step: consortium-v2 Plant palette redesign, push PP-B

shared.rule: the 11 flat locale files (pt in Brazilian Portuguese): a stream adds keys only under its prefix and changes or deletes only the existing keys its edits globs name; main's edits are the 'Plant palette' rename words (owner row 'Plant palette name'; consortium.download.* and what.plan.text keep the app's term) and the Balance keys it deletes; b1's privacy.location.link is the owner-approved replacement (decision row 2026-11-14); node scripts/plan/owners.mjs check fails any other key change against the chunk base; another key is requested from the main agent

probe on wrangler dev (query and fragment survive) else the stub-page fallback.
